info.title: CardiosensAI API
info.description:
API for the CardiosensAI connected health monitoring platform.

* **Patients, doctors and clinics** sign in with email and password and are identified by a 16-digit CardiosensAI ID.
* **Patients** upload readings from their devices, review history and ECG recordings, share selected data and create PDF reports.
* **Doctors and clinics** see a patient's data only after the patient approves a link, and only once CardiosensAI has verified them
  and they use two-step sign-in. Family members see only what a patient explicitly shared.
* **Administrators** manage accounts, device models and operations, and never receive health values.

Every reading keeps its device, acquisition mode (live, synced later, manual), quality and original UTC offset.
Uploads are idempotent: the reading's `id` is its idempotency key.

Not a diagnostic service. No clinical validation or medical-device certification is claimed.

syncError.title: Syncerror
syncError.description: Set when a sync attempt failed; omit/null on success

leads.title: Leads
leads.description: Multi-lead recordings: channel names in sample order (I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1–V6). Samples are then interleaved frames. Omit for a single-lead recording

samplesBase64.title: Samplesbase64
samplesBase64.description: Little-endian int16 samples in microvolts, base64-encoded

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: 0, 1, 2... Re-sending a seq that was already stored is ignored

samplesBase64.title: Samplesbase64
samplesBase64.description: Interleaved little-endian int16 frames (µV), at most 10 s

state.title: State
state.description: live: data within 5 s; stalled: no data for 5 s or more

leads.title: Leads
leads.description: Channel names in sample order; samples are interleaved frames when there are several

confirmUniqueId.title: Confirmuniqueid
confirmUniqueId.description: The account's 16-digit ID, typed again to confirm

inviteToken.title: Invitetoken
inviteToken.description: Shown once. Send it to the invitee; only its hash is stored.

granteeContact.title: Granteecontact
granteeContact.description: Email or mobile number for the invite

viaClinic.description: Set when a clinic requested this doctor link

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: incoming: the other side asked; outgoing: you asked

targetId.title: Targetid
targetId.description: 16-digit ID of the patient, doctor or clinic (spaces allowed)

onBehalfOfDoctorId.title: Onbehalfofdoctorid

doctors.title: Doctors

latest.title: Latest

ecgLive.title: Ecglive

webSession.title: Websession
webSession.description: true: refresh token goes in an httpOnly cookie, not the response body

LoginIn.title: LoginIn
LoginIn.description: Password sign-in. `identifier` (email or mobile number) replaces `email`, which older app builds send.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: Email address, or mobile number in E.164 (+91...)

historyLimitedFrom.title: Historylimitedfrom
historyLimitedFrom.description: Set when a sharing grant limits how far back you can see

OptionalRefreshIn.title: OptionalRefreshIn
OptionalRefreshIn.description: Body for refresh/logout: the app sends the token; the web app sends nothing and relies on the cookie.

devCode.title: Devcode
devCode.description: Only returned when DEV_EXPOSE_OTP is on (development)

accountType.title: Accounttype
accountType.description: Used only when creating a new account. 'caregiver' is accepted from older app builds and creates a patient

verified.title: Verified

PartyOut.title: PartyOut
PartyOut.description: Another account as seen across a link. Never includes contact details or health data.

currentPassword.title: Currentpassword
currentPassword.description: Not needed if the account has no password yet

phone.title: Phone

email.title: Email
email.description: Optional. Gets its own one-time code

password.title: Password
password.description: Required unless signing up with Google

fullName.title: Fullname
fullName.description: For a clinic: the name of the person managing the account

googleCredential.title: Googlecredential
googleCredential.description: Google ID token: the email comes from Google, verified

RegisterIn.title: RegisterIn
RegisterIn.description: Sign-up: a mobile number is required (it gets a code), an email is optional (it gets a code too).

utcOffsetMin.title: Utcoffsetmin

refreshToken.title: Refreshtoken
